title: Pace, Pressure and Decision Quality
before: Public service runs on deadlines, and some of them are real.

turns.text: In public service, a lot of things really are urgent. People are waiting on decisions that shape their lives. That's exactly why it matters to spend urgency carefully. In this course, you'll practice telling a real deadline from a habit, and protecting quality when the pressure is on.

guidance.text: Ask who absorbs the cost of moving fast. The answer is often the people with the least say.
Pick one number your team reports. What question about the outcome would sit well beside it?
When there's no extra time, naming what was cut is the responsible move.
